reply.summary: Sovosllo is a grinning, horned spirit that slips into lonely hosts and wears them like coats, feeding on their dread while stirring up mayhem. Sealed for decades inside an enchanted blade, it learned to torment fellow captives in cruel, patient loops.

feats.scene: Sovosllo hurls a possessed host through a brick wall with a single shove.
Sovosllo shrugs off a collision with a speeding truck while wearing a borrowed body.

reply.summary: Seril is a pipe-puffing inspector who works the foggy streets of an old capital in the years before a great war, chasing gunmen with more luck than grace. Rumpled and stubborn, the sleuth keeps shouting oaths whenever bullets fly.

feats.scene: Seril fires a revolver and drops a fleeing smuggler's lantern from forty paces.
Seril takes a thug's club across the shoulders and keeps on walking.

reply.summary: Stela is a bald, scheming patriarch who leads a secret order devoted to hurrying human evolution toward the gift of flight. Obsessed with reclaiming a rebellious descendant, the elder plots with surgical patience and scorn for gratitude.

feats.scene: Stela orders a lab wing detonated to cover the escape of a captured test subject.
Stela survives a hard fall from a balcony onto a stone courtyard.

reply.summary: Ranse is a pale-maned commander of a trio of off-world peacemakers who ride hovering boards through the night sky. Gentle in method, the leader can nudge gravity a little and prefers persuasion to fighting.

feats.scene: Ranse tugs at local gravity and drags a parked van across the road.
Ranse rides out a crash of her board into a hillside and walks away bruised.

reply.summary: Tivos is a pale-haired loner with a sly grin who hides behind a secret name and strikes from alley shadows. Little is known beyond a taste for chirping taunts and a habit of vanishing before anyone gives chase.

feats.scene: Tivos lands a quick jab that puts a night guard on the pavement.
Tivos tumbles down a fire escape and bounces straight back up.

reply.summary: Carntau is a bald racketeer who runs a noisy street gang from a rundown hideout, fond of grand threats and cheap tricks. Dangerous mostly through numbers, the boss sends underlings first and watches from afar.

feats.scene: Carntau empties a pistol at a rooftop pursuer and shatters a skylight.
Carntau absorbs a hard kick to the ribs and still barks orders.

reply.summary: Tertes is a bald lawbreaker who briefly challenged a teenage hero with a borrowed bag of tricks, relying on bluster and brute scheming. Short-lived but memorable for the sheer audacity of the plan.

feats.scene: Tertes swings a steel pipe and caves in a truck door.
Tertes is flung into a stack of crates and sits up laughing.

reply.summary: Illto is a meticulous woman who sells blueprints for robberies, marking every camera and wire and taking a cut of the haul. Underlings obey out of fear of the tiny fire devices hidden inside their clothing.

feats.scene: Illto triggers a hidden incendiary charge and burns down a disobedient crew's getaway van.
Illto is knocked flat by a rival's slap and rises with a calm smile.

reply.summary: Sillasria is an aged, brittle inventor who spent decades plotting vengeance with gadgets and old radio parts. A crawling, hovering metal hand obeys his remote signal, built to strangle the men who once jailed him.

feats.scene: Sillasria steers his clawed gauntlet through a window to crush a pane and a throat-sized pipe.
Sillasria endures a rough tackle by a pint-sized hero with only a groan.

reply.summary: Eoestli is a hairless hired killer who strikes with a hooked, scarlet blade and leaves almost no trace. Quiet and efficient, the assassin takes contracts against tiny crimefighters and miscreants alike.

feats.scene: Eoestli rakes the hooked blade through a heavy canvas awning in one pass.
Eoestli takes a thrown chair across the back and remains standing.

reply.summary: Ralreoti is an ordinary volunteer who gained sudden gifts from a billionaire's program and tried to guard a big city. The brief career ended in one chaotic clash against a rogue machine and its allies.

feats.scene: Ralreoti flings a flipped sedan across an intersection in a burst of new strength.
Ralreoti stands through a laser volley that melts a lamppost beside him before finally falling.

reply.summary: Ticoeru is a bearded detective from a possible grim tomorrow, a widower who walks his beat with dogged honesty until a masked killer cuts the story short.

feats.scene: Ticoeru fires his service pistol and stops a getaway car's tire mid-turn.
Ticoeru shoulders through a locked door and keeps his footing.

reply.summary: Coranleo is a scruffy raccoon who doubles as headgear for a cheerful drifter, riding along on his head through every scrape. Mischievous and sticky-fingered, the animal sneaks snacks and bites at ankles.

feats.scene: Coranleo clamps its jaws on a thief's ankle and refuses to let go.
Coranleo tumbles from a second-floor ledge and trots off unharmed.

reply.summary: Tercoam is an ancient, scarred shark who patrols the reef margins near a sunken city, missing an eye from a scrap with a baby. Memory is short in his kind, so grudges never last past the next meal.

feats.scene: Tercoam bites clean through a wooden rowboat's hull in a single lunge.
Tercoam rams a coral wall at full speed and swims on undeterred.

reply.summary: Llusiueo is an unseen presence from a shadowy underworld that lends its might to mortals it entraps. Hungry for forbidden texts, it sends its chosen servants back to the surface on errands of theft.

feats.scene: Llusiueo pours a surge of borrowed force into a servant and cracks a cathedral wall.
Llusiueo's shifting form disperses a cannon blast and reforms unhurt.

reply.summary: Luerura is a towering elder king of an age of gold, a ruler who swallowed his own offspring from dread of a prophecy and was finally dethroned and chained in a deep pit. Ancient, hulking, and patient, the tyrant still dreams of revenge.

feats.scene: Luerura tears a mountain slope loose and hurls it across a valley.
Luerura stands unmoved as a storm of divine lightning splits the ground around him.

reply.summary: Resval is a spoiled, volatile rich kid with a flair for theatrics who plays at villainy alongside two friends, driven by a bitter family quarrel. Bold in a brawl but out of her depth, she follows a darker mentor into a dream-like realm.

feats.scene: Resval swings a crowbar and snaps a factory railing.
Resval is punched by a masked teen and gets up with a sneer.

reply.summary: Tinal is a travelling medicine salesman who studied island burial rites and raises the fallen to serve as a shambling road crew. Greedy and cruel, the quack ends his career abandoned in the desert.

feats.scene: Tinal commands a dozen risen corpses to topple a stagecoach.
Tinal is thrown from a wagon and lands hard on baked clay.

reply.summary: Saucorstu is a hooded thief who prowls rooftops under a carrion-bird alias, snatching jewels at night and cawing taunts at the law. Not much more than a common burglar with a flamboyant costume.

feats.scene: Saucorstu cracks a safe door open with a heavy mallet.
Saucorstu drops onto a tin roof and rolls without injury.

reply.summary: Llellerni is a ruthless gang kingpin who rules a ring of fanged enforcers and resents any costumed rival with an eagle emblem. Calculating and cold, the crimelord prefers to watch from the shadows.

feats.scene: Llellerni has his hired men overturn a delivery truck to block a chase.
Llellerni staggers under a punch to the jaw yet keeps issuing commands.

reply.summary: Stito is a raven-haired agent of a covert strike team who bends sound into weapons, shrieking waves that rattle bones and glass alike. Killed on a first mission, she later returns as a reanimated copy and nearly wins a rematch.

feats.scene: Stito screams and shatters every window on a tower floor in one note.
Stito walks through a collapsing wall of rubble with only scratches.

reply.summary: Aramisau is a hairless lord of a cult of bloodsuckers who battled an aged rival for years and nearly ended him in an ambush. Sunlight and flame trouble him, but little else slows the predator.

feats.scene: Aramisau tosses a parked bus into a row of cultists' enemies.
Aramisau takes a concentrated beam of daylight and keeps advancing, only slowed.

reply.summary: Iarlen is a hulking, armoured relic of a vanished interstellar order, programmed to hunt a hidden alien kind and later posing as a campus lecturer. Convinced those aliens are not monsters after all, the last warrior's mind fractures between duty and doubt.

feats.scene: Iarlen drives a fist through the hull of a parked freighter.
Iarlen stands in the blast of a ruptured fuel depot and walks out of the fire.

reply.summary: Ravati is a zealot trained since boyhood in a hidden school of gifted killers, who scarred his own face with a glowing brand to prove devotion. Ravati stalks witnesses and murders them in gruesome mimicry of martyrs.

feats.scene: Ravati crushes a reinforced door and the man behind it in one blow.
Ravati ignores a sword cut that would cripple an ordinary fighter.

reply.summary: Stitena is a revived sleeper from a frozen experiment decades past who steals organs from hospitals with chilling gear in order to revive a spouse. Lying to the ghosts of his companions, the thief ends murdered by those he sought to save.

feats.scene: Stitena blasts a hospital freezer door off its hinges with a prototype coolant gun.
Stitena is slammed against a laboratory wall and slumps without dying.

reply.summary: Tineru is a hairless rebel from a ruined future where a conqueror drugged the whole planet into obedience. Working beside a partner, she recruits soldiers as spies and fights as an associate of a time-lost band.

feats.scene: Tineru fires a rifle burst that tears through a patrol vehicle's door.
Tineru takes a stun-baton hit to the ribs and still sprints for cover.

reply.summary: Rumve is a worried wife in a divergent timeline who resolves to expose her husband's crimes to the law, only to be forced into a fatal overdose staged as despair.

feats.scene: Rumve slaps a spouse's hand away from the telephone in a desperate bid.
Rumve is shoved against a kitchen counter and stays upright.

reply.summary: Larontel is an invading alien with a faceted gemstone body who can fire razor shards and transmute living beings into glittering thralls. Though immensely hard, a well-placed throwing blade can still crack him.

feats.scene: Larontel hurls a storm of shards that shreds a row of parked trucks.
Larontel is struck by a wrecking ball and merely chips at the corner.

reply.summary: Veontecor is a glacial-skinned scientist turned criminal who feeds on heat and turns it into freezing blasts. Teaming with other chilly rogues, she aims to lock a whole city in rime, but her own rivalry undoes the plan.

feats.scene: Veontecor exhales a cloud that coats a whole city block in rime.
Veontecor shrugs off a collapsing storefront while locked in a duel.

reply.summary: Rnese is a heartbroken researcher whose accident in a refrigerated chamber turned her into a brittle-hearted killer who sprays waves of bitter chill, bent on revenge against a former mentor. Later a captive of a villain league, she dies fighting.

feats.scene: Rnese flash-chills a warehouse so thoroughly that its pipes burst.
Rnese is slammed by a nuclear-fuelled hero and keeps fighting through the burn.

reply.summary: Enuial is a hairless being who dwells beyond the waking world, a serene watcher whose glassy body glows faintly. Few mortals meet the strange sentinel, and fewer understand its quiet purpose.

feats.scene: Enuial lets a pulse of radiance spill out and scorches a ring of cultists.
Enuial's glassy frame withstands a burst of occult force without a flaw.

reply.summary: Sasamo is a wisecracking young medium once hosted by a fiend for a year, who now helps ghostly sleuths chase her stolen memories. Dry and skittish, she calls up spirits when the case demands.

feats.scene: Sasamo summons a spirit that hurls a heavy table across a haunted hall.
Sasamo is knocked off her feet by a ghostly shove and bounces up.

reply.summary: Ntrotis is a dark-tressed thief who partners with a stage conjuror to steal a lethal gem and go on a crime spree. Betrayal ends them both when a dying partner exposes her to the gem's glow.

feats.scene: Ntrotis fires a pistol and drops her partner across a jewellery counter.
Ntrotis is thrown against a display case and glass rains down without cutting deeply.

reply.summary: Elnel is an infernal lord with burning eyes and a hairless hide, a fanged ruler of fiends who can step between dimensions and cannot be killed by ordinary means. Haughty and irritable, he answers summoners with scorn.

feats.scene: Elnel unleashes a wave of hellfire that flattens a district of a rival's fortress.
Elnel remains whole after an exploding stronghold buries him in molten rock.

reply.summary: Teanees is a field operative of a secretive squad that polices bizarre, impossible phenomena, working under a soft-sounding codename. Calm in the face of absurdity, the agent handles strange threats with practiced routine.

feats.scene: Teanees swings a baton and drives an anomaly's puppet-body into a wall.
Teanees is thrown through a flimsy partition and shakes it off.

reply.summary: Seoceo is a wiry young burglar turned reluctant ally, nimble on rooftops and skilled at disguise, locks and hacking. Protective of a sister, the thief joins a band of outcasts accused of a terrible crime.

feats.scene: Seoceo lands a flying kick that sends a guard sprawling into a stairwell.
Seoceo drops from a first-floor balcony and rolls to a clean stop.

reply.summary: Amollore is a quick-witted schoolkid whose sister fights bullies on his behalf, and who idolizes a caped protector who once saved them in an alley. Dreaming of wearing the hero's symbol, the teenager grows up resilient.

feats.scene: Amollore throws a desperate punch and bloodies a bully's lip.
Amollore is knocked down by a gang of bullies and crawls to his feet.

reply.summary: Tetauan is a politician chasing high office who secretly directs a spy bureau in a second persona, using bullying, blackmail and torture to keep that identity hidden. A scandal revealed by a daughter on live broadcast threatens everything.

feats.scene: Tetauan orders a convoy of agents to ram a rental car off a highway.
Tetauan sits through a heckling crowd's thrown bottles without flinching.

reply.summary: Oroni is a winged archer of affection whose arrows force the struck to adore the first stranger in view. Eternal and charming, the golden-haired god strolls through modern cities flirting with mortals and matchmaking for sport.

feats.scene: Oroni looses a volley of arrows that pins a stampeding herd to the plain.
Oroni ignores a toppling tower of masonry and brushes dust from his wings.

reply.summary: Iuinueo is a ruthless contract killer reared by mountain monks, who rigged a sacred selection, was exposed, and became an elite murderer, masked, anonymous and fluent in deadly technique. Even rivals say nobody has seen her bare face.

feats.scene: Iuinueo drives a strike through a plank door and the guard behind it.
Iuinueo drops three storeys onto a wet street and sprints away.

reply.summary: Rianavi is a fugitive swordswoman who flees her former order's hunters through a future city, bearing urgent news of a returned tyrant. Agile and stealthy, she buys a hero time with a final stand.

feats.scene: Rianavi cleaves a steel shutter with a swift diagonal cut.
Rianavi lands a flip from a rooftop onto concrete and keeps running.

reply.summary: Rusreoar is a hairless collector of living statues, whose gaze petrifies anyone who meets his eyes until dawn, and who stages grim galleries of victims. Shutting one's eyes is all it takes to beat him.

feats.scene: Rusreoar petrifies a whole prison block of escapees with a sweep of his stare.
Rusreoar is thrown into a pillar and sags into a captured heap.

reply.summary: Corrosasi is a collector of oddities who turns strange trinkets into criminal tools, from trick lamps to cursed trifles. Fond of showmanship, the schemer clashes with a masked dream-weaver.

feats.scene: Corrosasi sets off a booby-trapped vase that blows out a shop window.
Corrosasi is hurled into a shelf of antiques and gets up covered in dust.

reply.summary: Elavalnt is a hired crackling thug who throws arcs of lightning and carries on a dead partner's stage-effects trade. Cocky about his name, he corrects anyone who mispronounces it.

feats.scene: Elavalnt discharges a thick arc that blows out a whole row of streetlights.
Elavalnt is thrown against a transformer box and sparks harmlessly off his skin.

reply.summary: Ollnel is an ancient demigod sorcerer, spawn of a war god, who ruled by terror until a rival order bound his spirit into a battle helm. Now a roaming ghost that can take over bodies, he dreams of a second reign.

feats.scene: Ollnel hurls a storm of dark sorcery that levels a market district.
Ollnel's spirit endures a banishing rite that shatters his old fortress.

reply.summary: Sauunlle is a crooked tycoon who dons a lifelike grinning mask to usurp a notorious clown criminal, staging gag-murders until a plunge into a vat ends it. Vain and jealous, the impostor dies for a stolen reputation.

feats.scene: Sauunlle sprays a toxic gag-gas that fills a boardroom.
Sauunlle takes a punch from his rival and stays on his feet, laughing.

reply.summary: Riiumne is a lean, middling-height rogue who runs afoul of a masked rival, blasting away with whatever firearm he can grab. Short on backstory, the hothead lives for the next score.

feats.scene: Riiumne empties a shotgun and splinters a warehouse door.
Riiumne is pitched down a flight of steps and limps off.

reply.summary: Socor is a medal-winning multi-event athlete and inventor of floating robotic spheres who became a masked vigilante and later a research director at a government bureau. Warm and clever, he fights with brains and agility.

feats.scene: Socor directs his spheres to blast a lock and a door off its frame.
Socor leaps from a high platform with a canopy and lands on his feet.

reply.summary: Artaial is a centuries-old surgeon who cannot die, a serial killer through the eras who harvests organs to prolong a spouse's life and serves a wealthy master. A clinic in a modern city gives him fresh victims.

feats.scene: Artaial plunges a scalpel through a restraint strap and the bed beneath it.
Artaial heals fully after a bullet wound across his chest.

reply.summary: Viiasco is a young prodigy with half a dozen degrees who builds a powered exosuit to clear his name after a former employer pins a city-wide catastrophe on him. Driven and brilliant, he also tinkers with time travel.

feats.scene: Viiasco blasts a vault door off its hinges with his suit's cannon.
Viiasco rides out a hail of automatic fire inside his exosuit.
